Governing plan: docs/plans/2026-09-20-film-compiler-phase-plan.md
Phase-plan ticket: bd-01M2TAGST4EBFR1HM9Q3EWSYAH
Film parent: bd-01M2T32SGVJXR2RT3RTS2DCN9P

This ticket is an executable child created from the cold-reviewed filing payload. Its blocking edges are authoritative; parent relation is organizational only.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Add the checked compileFilm/AnchoredNarrativeCompilation API, sharing private deterministic stages while preserving text compile/NarrativeCompilation/TextModel returns.
2. Actual film input with two separated intervals, explicit point, two separately parsed descriptions, one root clause and one Held clause traverses resolution, placement, mentions, materialization and checked validation; inspect retained resolutions/gaps as well as nodes.
3. Admitted model and general AlignmentSource retain every native/primary anchor and exact interval union/point; primary projection determines order and proposal text never becomes physical evidence.
4. Owner-selected explicit license, actual receipt/model joins, successful and blocked validation, and source-input permutation controls execute through public factories, not fixture bypasses.
5. Through actual compileFilm output, a claim using only description A includes A parse/derivation calls and excludes unrelated B calls; a claim using both includes both and retains shared upstream calls. This tests emitted provenance, beyond the F1 input helper.
6. Foreign bundle/axis/receipt, stale same-ID full binding, native-unit substitution and Held fallback have decisive compiled mutations and passing controls; complete text/S0 and consumer courts remain green.

Required gates:
- Separate committed-source SD6 cold review with findings resolved.
- Named compiled mutations and independent accepting controls; compile-door witnesses clean both Compile and Test and prove both recompilations.
- Clean exact-candidate standalone provider compileAll/testAll, separate format checks, frozen S0 values and applicable WOG backend byte court.
- Executable docs examples for public API changes; exact-pinned storyatlas consumer suite when its dependencies or interfaces are touched.
- Local evidence and commits only; no push or scientific/CI qualification implied.

Scope limits:
- Engineering compiler witness only; no scientific accuracy, end-to-end film alignment proof, V1 or E0 closure.

Plan sections: §9.
set.title: [film] compile a synthetic film through the deterministic stages
